title: Aye Chand Moharram Ke Tu Badli Me Chala Ja
body:
Aye Chand Moharram Ke Tu Badli Me Chala Ja
Tujhe Dek Ke Marjaye Na Bimar Hai Sugra
Ghar Zehra Ka Lootne Kiqabar Tum Ne Sunaee
Tujhe Dekh Ke Roti Hai Moharram Me Khudaee
<<DIVIDER>>
Chouda Sou Baras Bite Hai Sab Karte Hain Shikwa
Milne ke Liye Bhai Ko Bechain Padi Hai
Kabse Ali Akbar Ki Raahon Me Khadi Hai
Bichdi Hai Ye Muddart Seise Tu Na Nazar Aa
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran Gharoun Me Na Ise Neend Hai Ayi
Akbar Ki Judai Hai Ise Khoob Rulati
Khadmoun Ke Nishan Daanp Ke Baithi Hai Sar-e-rah
Gin Gin Ke Jo Sugra Ne Ye Din Hai Guzare
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda Hai To Akbar Ke Wadoun Ke Sahare
Din Raat Tadapti Hai Ise Aur Na Tadpa
Behnou Ka Tho Bhai Se Rishta Hi Ajab Hai
Tum Bhool Gaye Mujko Kaisa yeh Ghaazab Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Is Aas Pe Zinda Houn Ke Dekhoun Tera Sehra
Wada Kiya Behna Se Seene Se Laga Ke
Main Shadi Karunga Tho Tere Paas Hi Aakey
Qath Aaya Na Akbar Ka Roti Rahi Sughra
